# Joy Irine Barnayha — Automation & AI Architect

> Joy Irine Barnayha is an Automation & AI Architect who designs and builds automation systems, AI agents, and workflow solutions that run businesses on autopilot, 24 hours a day. She works with GoHighLevel, Make.com, n8n, Zapier, Claude AI, Vapi, and ElevenLabs.

Joy helps businesses eliminate manual work through smart systems, AI agents, and integrations — from GoHighLevel CRM setup and Make.com automation workflows to AI voice agents and digital twins. Clients do not need technical knowledge; she handles the full setup end-to-end, from strategy to build. Projects start with a free call, and pricing depends on project scope.

## Services

- GHL Setup & Management: full GoHighLevel CRM setup — pipelines, funnels, calendars, automations, sub-accounts
- Make.com Automation: custom scenarios connecting apps and automating complex multi-step workflows
- Zapier Workflows: automations connecting 5,000+ apps
- AI Phone Assistant: 24/7 AI voice agents that answer inbound calls, qualify leads, book appointments, and handle FAQs
- AI Integration: voice AI agents, chatbots, and digital twins built with Claude AI, Vapi, and ElevenLabs
- Landing Pages & Funnels: high-converting landing pages and sales funnels in GHL or custom HTML

## Problems Joy solves

- Leads waiting hours for a reply or going cold: speed-to-lead systems that reply within minutes and follow up automatically until the lead books (GoHighLevel, n8n, Make.com).
- Missed calls after hours and on weekends: 24/7 AI phone assistants that answer, qualify, book appointments and log every call to the CRM (ElevenLabs, Vapi, Twilio, Claude).
- Leads scattered across forms, calls, Facebook and email: one GoHighLevel pipeline where every inquiry is captured and moved from new lead to paid.
- Copy-paste admin between apps: Make.com and Zapier automations that move data between CRM, Google Sheets, email, Slack, calendars and payments, with error alerts.
- The same questions asked again and again: AI assistants trained on the business's own information that reply, qualify and book, and escalate to a person when needed.
- Website visitors who leave without acting: landing pages and funnels with one clear next step, connected to the CRM for instant follow-up.

## Live demos (built by Joy, not client projects)

- [AI Sales System for Construction](https://construction.joyirinebarnayha.com/): answers every inquiry, books site visits, sends proposals, contracts and deposit invoices
- [AI Sales System for Med Spa](https://medspa-demo-one.vercel.app/): replies to inquiries, qualifies and books consultations, treatment plan and deposit flow
- [AI Sales System for HVAC](https://hvac-demo-site-phi.vercel.app/): replies to service requests, books visits, sends quotes and deposit invoices
- AI version of Joy on the homepage: call or chat with it about her services
